acceptance: PROVISIONAL; numeric RMS/companion bounds pass; full raster and browser verified; regional limits retained
limitations: Six independent checks give RMS 51.33 m, median 35.24 m, P95 86.13 m and maximum 91.89 m. The 100 m RMS ceiling and suggested numerical companion bounds pass; this remains regional validation.

Summers and Mattie/Clyne Lake modern shorelines are reservoirs (WARS20). Their control/check proposals were excluded before any fit or score because historical water-level equivalence is unestablished.

Pomquet Island, William Lake and Tracadie Lake each have one control and a separate endpoint check, so these samples are spatially correlated. Western and southern parcel interiors, reservoirs and many minor waterbodies remain insufficiently validated.
Mary Dismal Lake supplies an excluded southeastern check beyond strong local control coverage. Pomquet Forks and Delory corner have 18 px working source uncertainty; other adopted points use 12 px.

review.statistics: 6 independent checks: RMS 51.33 m, median 35.24 m, P95 86.13 m, maximum 91.89 m. 6 controls; fit unchanged after scoring.
review.coverage: Complete original mapped frame includes Pomquet and Bayfield shores, Pomquet Island, Bowman Head and Delory Island, Tracadie Harbour, Cape Jack and Havre Boucher, all inland lakes/parcel regions and St Georges Bay. No displaced inset identified. Reservoir imagery and minor islands remain present despite exclusion from point fitting.
